page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, indicating a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio.

This server type is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Additionally, the instance does not feature any GPU acceleration.

For connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 and the dedicated CPU allocation, this server is designed for memory-intensive workloads. Suitable use cases include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that require substantial memory capacity without local storage dependencies.
